title: Carry principal, expiry, and trust origin on every graph invocation
narrative: Every graph run needs a capability-scoped execution token: principal, expiry, trust origin, and authorization epoch alongside grants and tools. Child graphs receive attenuated authority only (`fangore_capability_envelope_narrow`, `fangore_capability_envelope_narrow`): a child cannot raise the authorization epoch, swap principal or trust origin, or outlive the parent's expiry. Tracks MH-DOTS-01[^insp-dots-01].
implementation: `CapabilityEnvelope` carries `principal`, `expires_at`, `trust_origin`, and `authorization_epoch`; `narrow()` refuses a higher epoch, a different non-None principal or trust origin, and a later (or unorderable opaque) `expires_at`, and inherits omitted fields. `is_expired()` checks ISO expiry. Run identity stays on `GraphRunContext`; allowed operations are the envelope's grants and tools.
validation: Harness `cli` scenario `execution_token_narrow.yaml`. Hard expects on declared observation keys.
